Preferred

• Training in linguistics, translation, or interpreting.

Start Date

• Immediate . High volume of work expected between 26 to 31 Aug .
Application Process (Takes 20-30 mins to complete)

• Submit your resume or relevant background.

• Complete a short calibration task on sample sessions, assessed on scoring consistency and comment usefulness.

title: Data Engineer, Forward Deployed
description:
Applied Computing was founded in 2024 to build Orbital, a physics-informed foundation model for energy operations. We’re live across oil and gas, refineries, and petrochemicals, working towards our mission: sustainable
abundance for a growing planet.
The hydrocarbon industry keeps the world running. But its complexity has left operators tied to legacy systems, making critical decisions on less than 10% of available data. We built Orbital to change that. It’s a foundation model built specifically for energy that lets companies use AI at scale, harnessing all of their operational
data and optimising in real time for any metric. Decisions get faster, operations get safer, and carbon intensity falls.
We’ve raised over $32 million, including one of the largest seed rounds for an
AI company in the UK. We’re just getting started
The Role
As our Data Engineer, you’ll architect and maintain pipelines that make high-frequency time-series, lab, and historian data into a scalableLakehouse architecture, usable for both deep learning models and real-time LLMs. You’ll be working acrossAWS (EKS, S3, EBS, KMS, CloudWatch)andDatabricks/PySpark, ensuring data is contextualised, synchronised, and optimised for both deep learning models and real-time LLM workloads.
This isn’t a traditional ETL role, you’ll be solving problems at the intersection ofcontrol systems, industrial data engineering, and AI enablement.
Technical Requirements

• Deep expertise in PostgreSQL (partitioning, indexing, query optimisation, storage design).

• Strong proficiency in Python for data processing, scripting, and pipeline orchestration.

• Hands-on experience with AWS (EKS, S3, EBS, IAM, KMS, CloudWatch, etc.)for secure and scalable data pipelines.

• Proven ability to work with Databricks and PySpark for large-scale distributed data processing.

• Familiarity with time-series industrial data (control systems, DCS/SCADA logs, process historians).

• Experience in unstructured data sync and management within hybrid cloud/on-prem environments.

• Bonus: Experience working as a data engineer in oil and gas or energy environments

• Bonus: Knowledge of streaming frameworks (Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming) or MLOps stacks for data versioning and lineage.

Core Responsibilities
1. Ingest & Contextualise Data

• Ingest from OPC UA servers, process historians, IoT sensors, LIMS systems, alarms/events, and P&IDs.

• Map signals to their physical processes (tags, units, hierarchies) for interpretability in AI pipelines.

2. Data Movement & Accessibility

• Build pipelines that handle real-time streaming and batch ingestion into the Lakehouse.

• Manage synchronisation between historian archives, unstructured files, and AWS storage (S3/EBS).

• Orchestrate Databricks Lakeflow/Connectors for integrating data into Lakebase/Lakehouse.

• Handle secure, high-throughput transfers between historian archives and sandbox/live environments.

3. Change Tracking & Integrity

• Detect and manage schema changes, signal drift, and inconsistencies acrosstime.

• Implement lineage and audit trails across Spark/Databricks and AWS pipelines.

4. Data Preparation for AI

•
Build and maintaindual pipelines:

• Training→ large-scale historical data prep for time-series + LLM training.

• Inference→ low-latency, real-time pipelines for anomaly detection, optimisation, and LLM search.

• Support heterogeneous AI workloads (time-series forecasting and retrieval-augmented LLMs).

5. Database Performance & Optimisation

• Tune PostgreSQLand sparkfor high-throughput time-series workloads (partitioning, indexing, query optimisation).

• Optimise pipelines for both fast analytical queries and high-efficiency model training.

• Deploy and manage data pipelines in AWS EKS (Kubernetes) with persisten tEBS-backed storage.

What Success Looks Like

• Live data streams are contextualised,queryable, and AI-ready.

• Schema changes and signal drift are detected and handled without breaking downstream workflows.

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission - to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders - only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

The Firefox Platform Layout/APZ team is a global community of engineers who care deeply about how the Web looks and feels. We are the team responsible for Pan, Scrolling, Zoom, Page Layout, CSS, images, text, printing, and animations in Gecko, the engine behind Firefox. You will be able to design and develop standards-compliant CSS and page layout features that all of our users see, with a current particular focus on Asynchronous Pan and Zoom (APZ), our technology for making user interaction snappy and delightful. Our team is geographically-distributed, and working virtually and in the open is the norm. You can expect to work on the code driving the Firefox browser on a number of platforms - Android, Windows, Linux, and macOS. Our focus is on writing fast, lightweight and maintainable code to make Firefox phenomenal for users.

• Help triage and test bugs, taking the initiative to drill down to root causes and explore potential solutions

What you’ll bring:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science or similar field

• Experience developing C/C++ and/or Rust applications

• Strong debugging and optimization skills in a multi-threaded environment

• Experience with memory and performance optimization tools

• Proven record of finishing projects where the work spans several months

• Experience participating in and contributing to open source projects and/or web browser development would be beneficial.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Ability to quickly learn and be effective with a large code base

title: Senior Director, Product and Technology
description:
Senior Director, Product and Technology

Location: Remote,

Application Submission Deadline: November 1, 2026

About Us

Propel America addresses a broken workforce system that fails both young adults and healthcare employers, sidelining talented individuals from entering healthcare careers and contributing to critical workforce shortages that threaten community health. Propel’s work centers on bridging this gap by creating alternative, debt-free career pathways into healthcare for young adults ages 18-26, particularly those from underrepresented and low-income backgrounds, while helping employers access the trained, diverse talent they urgently need. Today, over 13 million young adults in the U.S. are either not in school, not working, or stuck in low-wage jobs with little room for growth. Traditional college remains financially and logistically out of reach for many, especially young people from low-income communities, forcing them into a false choice: sacrifice income to pursue an expensive degree or remain in low-wage work without upward mobility. At the same time, systemic barriers, such as limited exposure to healthcare roles, low visibility of alternative pathways, and a lack of representative mentors, prevent many high school graduates from entering the healthcare field.

Meanwhile, healthcare employers face compounding workforce shortages. The Bureau of Labor Statistics projects a 13% growth in healthcare jobs from 2021 to 2031, translating to nearly 2 million openings annually. Many of these are middle-skill roles, which represent over half the U.S. labor market but remain unfilled due to a lack of training infrastructure. Employers often contend with high turnover in entry-level positions yet underinvest in structured career advancement pathways or innovative strategies to retain talent.

Propel America aims to solve both sides of the equation, by equipping young adults with the skills and support to launch healthcare careers and by helping employers build stronger, more diverse, and more stable workforces. In our portfolio, we offer a suite of Propel Paths and Propel Products to place young adults in critical talent gaps in healthcare

To learn more about Propel America , please visit .

The Opportunity

Propel America is undergoing an exciting phase of growth and technological transformation, marked by the development of our signature Fellow Portal and the integration of cutting-edge AI technologies into our program delivery. To lead this effort, we are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Director, Product and Technology.

This role sits within our newly formed Solutions Team and reports directly to the Vice President of Solutions.

The Director will serve as our core technology lead, managing the technical implementation of our product roadmap, maintaining the integrity of our overall technology stack, and directly supervising our technical staff (Salesforce Administrator and Junior Product Developer).

Key Responsibilities

The ideal candidate is a product developer who can set a vision and design the technology roadmap while also architecting integrations, managing developers and salesforce administration as well as overseeing outsourced Managed Service Providers (MSPs). The Direct will act as the critical link between Propel’s strategic vision and our day-to-day software execution, ensuring that our infrastructure is secure, scalable, and built to support our fellows' journey

Key Responsibilities include

• Product leadership 40%

• Technology stack management and development 40%

• Cross Functional Collaboration (20%)

• Product Leadership

• Develop technology roadmap and set vision for Propel’s technology products including the Applicant and Fellow Portal to ensure they are responsive to fellows and employer needs

• Directly manage the Junior Product Developer in building and iterating on the Fellow Portal, ensuring coding standards, version control, and security practices are rigorously maintained.

At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

Your Impact at LILA

As an AI Research Recruiter at Lila Sciences, you will partner directly with our AI research and engineering teams to identify, engage, and hire the researchers and engineers building our AI-driven platform. This is a strategic, full-cycle role: you'll shape hiring plans with research leadership, build Lila's reputation in the AI research community, and go deep in high-signal technical channels to reach talent that isn't sitting on a job board.

What You'll Be Building

• Develop and execute strategic recruiting plans for AI/ML research and engineering roles, from hiring-manager intake through screen, interview loop management, offer strategy, and close.

• Partner with AI Research hiring managers and interview panels to translate team needs into sourcing strategy, candidate personas, and role calibration.

• Build and sustain a high-trust network of ML researchers and applied scientists across subfields (LLM, RL, Generative AI) through consistent relationship-building, community presence, and non-traditional discovery loops (research publications, GitHub, conferences, open-source).

• Partner with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to map long-term AI/ML talent strategy and balance hiring priorities across research teams.

• Build and iterate on recruiting processes that maintain a high, consistent talent bar while actively removing bias from the hiring process.

• Strengthen Lila's employer brand within the ML research and scientific community - representing our mission, culture, and technical work to candidates with strong options elsewhere.

• Stay current on sourcing techniques, interview innovation, and AI/ML talent-market trends; bring new approaches back to the team.

• Maintain operational rigor: pipeline hygiene, recruiting metrics (time-to-fill, slate quality, source efficacy), and clear communication with candidates and hiring teams.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience supporting technical research teams, with a track record of recruiting AI/ML research talent specifically.

• Strong existing network in the ML research community (NeurIPS, ICML, top CS/ML programs).

• Proven ability to attract passive candidates from leading academic institutions and frontier labs, and to scale a high-performing technical hiring function.

• Strong technical aptitude - comfortable understanding and evaluating ML/research qualifications alongside hiring managers.

• Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills with senior technical leaders.

• Comfortable operating with autonomy and juggling shifting priorities in a fast-moving environment.

Bonus Points For

• Deep interest in AI's potential and a realistic view of its risks and limitations - genuine enthusiasm for Lila's scientific mission.

• Hands-on experience with agentic recruiting tools/workflows (automations, enrichment/triage helpers) to improve candidate discovery.

• Experience recruiting at a deep-tech or frontier AI research organization.

• International recruiting experience across multiple regions.

Compensation

title: Manager, Technology Category Management
description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

The Manager, Technology Category Management executes category strategy and sourcing activity for assigned technology spend within one of three categories: Hardware/Telecom/Cloud, Software, or Technology Services. The role identifies, negotiates and delivers productivity, manages supplier relationships, and partners with business and IT stakeholders to capture value. The Manager partners with peer category leads and may guide analysts supporting the category. This role is critical to delivering savings, risk reduction and supplier performance for the enterprise.

Responsibilities

• Category execution: Manage category strategies, sourcing plans and pipeline priorities for assigned spend areas, aligned with business demand, service, quality and cost objectives; develop the annual plan for assigned spend and contribute to the broader category plan.

• Productivity identification: Analyze spend, demand and market data to identify productivity (cost savings and cost avoidance) opportunities such as consolidation, demand management, renegotiation, rate and license optimization and process improvement; maintain the opportunity pipeline for assigned spend.

• Sourcing and negotiation: Lead sourcing events, supplier evaluations, negotiations and award recommendations to secure commercial value and category continuity within policy and control requirements; manage contracts within delegated authority and escalate complex or high-value commercial and contractual issues to the Director.

• Contract expertise: MSA, Saas, Cloud Agreements and demonstrate expertise in technology contract terms (pricing models, licensing rights, IP etc..), governance practices to ensure compliance to maximize long term value.

• Productivity delivery: Deliver negotiated productivity through realization, validating savings against baseline spend with Finance, driving implementation and business adoption of negotiated terms, and tracking benefits to completion.

• Supplier management: Manage supplier performance, contract compliance and issue resolution to address service, quality, risk and supply concerns; run supplier reviews, track SLAs and KPIs, and flag financial and cyber risk.

• Stakeholder coordination: Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders (business, IT, Legal, Finance, Security, Regional Sourcing/Country Leads) to align requirements, specifications, timelines and handoffs; serve as primary contact with business and vendor counterparts for assigned spend and provide timely status updates with risks and recommendations to the Director.

• Budget and savings tracking: Manage budgets, savings tracking and delivery plans for assigned spend using financial, capacity and quality metrics; report performance to the Director and leadership.

• Market insight: Maintain current knowledge of market trends, emerging technologies (e.g., cloud, AI, cybersecurity) and vendor capabilities to inform sourcing approaches and negotiation positions.

• MA&D support: Support MA&D and corporate initiatives, including vendor overlap and synergy analysis, due diligence, Day-1 readiness and post-transaction integration or separation.

• Process improvement: Contribute to process improvements, onboarding, cross-training and local standardization efforts; follow and help maintain category policies, procedures and playbooks, and support adoption of approved tools and practices.

• Team guidance: Provide day-to-day guidance and coaching to analysts and other team members on analysis, sourcing events and best practices; support clear routines, accountability and escalation paths.

description:
Title:
Systems Engineer
At KBR, we deliver science, technology and engineering solutions to governments and companies around the world. KBR employs approximately 37,000 people worldwide with customers in more than 85 countries and operations in over 28 countries. KBR is proud to work with its customers across the globe to provide technology, value-added services, and long-term operations and maintenance services to ensure consistent delivery with predictable results.

Trinzic is the future independent company to be created through the planned spin-off of KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business, expected in January 2027. Our people work at the frontier of what is possible, delivering solutions in challenging environments and advancing some of the world's highest-priority national security and space missions. 

Backed by decades of mission success, deep expertise, and trusted partnerships, Trinzic will launch as a global organization with more than 18,000 employees supporting customers around the world. Join us at a defining moment and help shape the future of a company built to tackle complex challenges and make a meaningful impact. 

Candidates who join KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business before the spin-off will transition to Trinzic when the separation is complete and will not need to reapply for employment. 

Position Summary and Responsibilities
KBR is seeking a Systems Engineer to support the development, evaluation, and implementation of a Verification and Validation (V&V) Analysis Tool supporting NASA mission activities. The selected candidate will apply systems engineering principles to requirements analysis, V&V assessment, technical baseline management, engineering artifact review, and stakeholder coordination activities.

Responsibilities
• Requirements analysis, traceability, and technical baseline support.
• Review verification and validation artifacts for completeness, consistency, and compliance.
• Assess alignment between requirements, verification methods, and verification results.
• Participate in technical reviews, stakeholder meetings, and working groups.
• Evaluate tool outputs against mission expectations and document findings.
• Maintain engineering repositories, technical records, and project documentation.
• Support configuration management and technical baseline control activities.
• Prepare technical reports, briefings, status updates, and engineering recommendations.
Required and Preferred Qualifications, Education, and Experience
Minimum Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline.
• 5-8 years of systems engineering experience.
• Experience supporting requirements development, management, or analysis.
• Knowledge of systems engineering lifecycle processes.
• Experience supporting verification and validation activities.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Requirements
• Experience supporting NASA, FAA, DoD, or other federal programs.
• Master's degree in Systems Engineering or related discipline.

Jobs on this contract range from $109,300.00- $164,000.00 Pay range is specific to the U.S. National area.

The offered rate will be based on the position, contract affordability, the selected candidate’s working location, knowledge, skills, abilities, experience, and in consideration of internal parity.

KBR may offer bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation to certain job titles or levels, per internal policy or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be in the form of sign on bonus, relocation benefits, short-term incentives, long-term incentives, or discretionary payments for exceptional performance.

title: Senior Business Risk Analyst
description:
Crisis24 AiiA is seeking a Senior Business Risk Analyst with deep expertise in corporate risk and financial analysis to assess complex business and financial risks. This role will combine subject matter expertise with advanced analytical capabilities, including the use of AI to accelerate and enhance risk analysis, evaluate emerging trends, and assess how geopolitical, economic, financial, financial, operational, regulatory, and security developments may impact client organizations.
What You Will Do:
Own the end-to-end development of AI-enabled corporate risk assessments, including prompt engineering, assessment methodology, testing and validation, and final delivery. Continuously refine AI outputs to ensure accurate, relevant, and actionable risk intelligence for clients. Assess corporate risk across geopolitical, economic, financial, operational, regulatory, reputational, and security dimensions, identify exposure and forecast emerging threats and opportunities.
Leverage AI capabilities and AI-enabled platforms to conduct analysis at speed and scale: synthesizing large and disparate data sets, surfacing signals, modeling exposure, and stress-testing analytic judgments.
Employ AI to produce a full range of intelligence analysis products, including executive briefings, threat and financial-risk assessments, country and market-entry assessments, risk forecasts, and bespoke research.
Collaborate with analysts, subject-matter experts, and platform/technology teams to refine intelligence outputs, strengthen AI-assisted workflows, and improve analytic tradecraft.
Maintain analytic objectivity, sourcing rigor, and quality standards across all products, including appropriate human oversight of AI-generated outputs.
What You Will Bring:
Bachelor's degree (Economics, Finance, or Business is preferred). Minimum of 7 years of experience assessing business and financial risk intelligence analysis products. Demonstrated expertise with both corporate risk and financial analysis methodologies, including risk assessment frameworks and financial/economic analytic techniques. Hands-on experience using AI capabilities and AI-enabled tools to conduct analysis-for example, to process large data sets, generate insights, or accelerate the production of analytic products-paired with sound judgment in validating AI-generated outputs. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex risk and financial analysis clearly to senior, non-specialist decision-makers. Proven ability to work under deadline pressure while maintaining accuracy and analytic integrity.
Preferred Qualifications
Professional credentials or formal training in financial analysis or risk management (e.g., CFA, FRM, or equivalent). Advanced degree and/or deep experience with corporate risk and financial analysis.

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is an entry-level role for someone who wants to start a career in operations at a financial services firm. You'll join our UK Customer Operations team and train to become a fully competent front-line agent, supporting customers across our personal loans, credit cards and car finance. That covers everything from general service queries to more intricate financial support situations. By taking ownership of every enquiry from first contact to final resolution, you will not only deliver exceptional customer outcomes but also provide actionable feedback and insights to help improve our automated tools and AI-driven customer journeys

You'll be based in our Chatham office three days a week and work two weekend days a month (one Saturday and one Sunday), with a day in lieu the week before so you never work more than five days in a week.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Resolving general customer service and financial support queries across any one of our products in either loans, cards or car finance over multiple channels, following established processes

- Owning each enquiry from first contact to resolution, or escalating it to the right place when it needs to go further

title: Finance Analytics Engineer | FP&A
description:
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Do you like knowing exactly why a number moved? As an Finance Analytics Engineer at ARQ, you'll own the data foundations behind our revenue, cost and management reporting. You'll sit between Finance and Engineering: building the models that tell us how the business is performing, keeping them accurate every day, and turning them into insight that leadership uses to make decisions.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is as comfortable in a dbt project or a Python codebase as in a P&L. You'll work closely with Finance, Treasury and Engineering, and your work will feed management, investor and regulatory reporting directly.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Own the finance data layer: Maintain and extend our dbt repo. That means building and refactoring models, writing tests, and keeping finance data clean, documented and reliable.

- Revenue and cost models: Build and maintain the models behind revenue, unit economics and operations costs (payment rails, FX, card, banking partners, vendors) across our markets.

- Management accounts: Support daily and monthly management accounts on both accrual and cash basis. Reconcile them to source systems and explain movements.

- Budgeting and forecasting: Feed actuals into the budget and forecast, run variance analysis, and help Finance understand what is driving performance.

- Python services: Help maintain and improve the internal Python services and pipelines that support finance reporting and reconciliation.

- Data mapping and requirements: Map data sources across our product and payments stack, and document business logic and assumptions so others can trust and reuse your work.

- Onboard new business: When we launch a new product, partner or market, make sure it flows correctly into financial reporting, controls and processes.

- Dashboards and reporting: Build and improve dashboards with Finance and Controllership that track key metrics and surface business drivers.

- Anomalies and controls: Spot breaks, unusual spikes or data quality issues early, find the root cause, and fix it at the source.

- Data literacy: Help the wider team understand and self-serve finance data.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- 3+ years in a data, analytics or FP&A role, ideally in fintech, banking or payments

- Strong SQL and solid Python

- Hands-on experience with dbt (or a similar transformation tool) and version control (Git)

- A good grasp of financial statements, management accounts and core finance concepts (accruals, revenue recognition, unit economics)

- A quantitative background, through education or experience

- Strong attention to detail and a quality-first mindset, while still able to work to tight deadlines

- Clear communication: you can explain a variance to a CFO and a data model to an engineer

- Initiative to automate repetitive work and improve how things are done

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with regulatory or external reporting

- Exposure to reconciliations, treasury or general ledger data

- Experience with BI tools (Metabase, Looker, Power BI) and orchestration tools (Airflow or similar)

- Experience maintaining production code: code review, testing, CI/CD

- Spanish or Portuguese proficiency

BENEFITS

- Competitive salary and benefits

- Stock options, so you own part of what you build

- Discretionary performance bonus

- The latest tools and technology

- A world-class team that will challenge and grow your skills

- The opportunity to help build the best fintech app in Latin America

- Office Policy: 3-4 days a week in-office

You will deploy, harden, integrate, and operate our modular C-UAS solution.

Forward-deployed means aligned with the mission hero , not always on a plane . Most of the work is remote. You'll travel to sites when the engagement genuinely calls for it - initial standup, in-SCIF integration work, on-the-ground incident response, training, and knowledge transfer- and you'll be on a video call or in a shared chat with that same mission hero the rest of the time. The job is being their engineer, not living at their desk.

You are a cross-functional engineering leader. You can take responsibility for the full breadth of a data and software integration platform- make it work where it has to work, analyze what's running through it, and solve problems in real time for the mission hero. About 20% of your time, you'll also help make Defense Unicorns' forward-deployed team better - pairing with junior Data Engineer FDEs on hard problems, helping them develop technical judgment, and raising the ceiling on what the team can take on.

Responsibilities

•
Deploy and harden UDS Data Capability in the mission hero's environment - stand up UDS Store (Iceberg, Rook/Ceph, pgvector, Postgres), wire up UDS Transit for air-gap data movement, configure UDS Govern policies (Pepr/Lula), and integrate UDS Connect (Strimzi/Kafka) where streaming or legacy connectors are required.

•
Own integration with existing mission systems - connect UDS Data Capability to existing infrastructure, including sensor arrays, computer-vision-enabled UAS interceptors, and a broad range of C-UAS solutions.

•
Build pipelines that move data through classification boundaries - ingestion, transformation, catalog registration, model/dataset packaging via Zarf, cross-domain transit, and eventual consistency across DDIL conditions.

•
Operate what you deploy - own initial day-2 operations, including capacity, performance, backup/restore (Velero), observability (Vector/Loki), incident response, and upgrade paths. Transition ownership to the mission hero's operations team once stable.

•
Generate accreditation artifacts - STIG evidence, cATO documentation, FIPS validation notes, and policy mappings to support ISSM/ISSO requirements in IL4/IL5 environments.

•
Represent the mission hero to product and engineering - document issues, write postmortems, recommend operator improvements, and communicate field challenges to the platform engineering team.

•
Train and transfer knowledge - develop runbooks, architecture documentation, working sessions, and knowledge-transfer materials that enable mission teams to operate independently.

•
Mentor junior Data Engineer FDEs - pair on complex problems, review integration designs, and help engineers develop technical judgment without direct people-management responsibilities.

Clearance & Travel

•
Clearance: Active TS/SCI required.

•
Travel: Approximately 10%-25%, based on mission and customer requirements.

•
On-site expectations: Ability to work in SCIFs and other restricted environments for days or weeks when required for integration, incident response, training, or knowledge transfer. Most work is performed remotely.

Required Qualifications

• Experience working in tactical edge and interoperable mission environments, including TAK Server administration, ATAK/WinTAK, tactical communications, and disconnected or air-gapped systems.

• Production experience with modern data platforms, including lakehouse technologies (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi), object storage (Ceph or S3-compatible), PostgreSQL, and analytical query engines

title: Director - Payor Relations - Regional
description:
PURPOSE OF JOB
The Director, Payer Relations - Regional is responsible for developing and executing regional payer engagement and coverage strategy for the TearCare® System. The role builds sustained relationships with Medicare Administrative Contractors, regional commercial health plans, Blue Cross and Blue Shield plans, Medicaid organizations, integrated delivery networks, and other healthcare decisionmakers to advance appropriate patient access and establish clear, evidence based coverage policies.
This leader translates national Market Access priorities into focused regional plans, leads payer discussions regarding TearCare clinical evidence, coding, coverage, and payment, and coordinates cross-functional resources to address policy barriers. The Director serves as the regional payer-relations lead and is accountable for developing engagement plans, monitoring policy activity, preparing coverage submissions, and communicating actionable payer insights to executive and commercial leadership.
MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop and execute a regional payer-relations strategy for TearCare aligned with Market Access, commercial, clinical, medical, legal, and compliance priorities.

• Prioritize regional payer organizations based on patient impact, policy opportunity, access barriers, provider needs, and business priorities; maintain account-specific engagement and coverage plans.

• Build and maintain professional relationships with payer medical directors, policy leaders, reimbursement teams, provider-relations leaders, pharmacy or technology assessment committees where applicable, and other economic decisionmakers.

• Lead compliant payer meetings and discussions focused on TearCare clinical evidence, patient population, treatment pathway, coding, coverage, payment, health-economic considerations, and provider experience.

• Monitor existing and emerging payer coverage policies, medical policies, clinical criteria, technology assessments, coding edits, prior-authorization requirements, and reimbursement practices affecting TearCare.

• Develop and coordinate payer coverage submissions, reconsideration requests, evidence dossiers, policy comment letters, and follow-up responses using approved clinical, economic, coding, and reimbursement materials.

• Engage Medicare Administrative Contractors and other government payer stakeholders within the assigned region regarding coverage, coding, payment, claims experience, and provider-access barriers in accordance with applicable requirements.

• Partners with Medical Affairs, Clinical, Health Economics and Outcomes Research, Regulatory, Legal, and Compliance to identify evidence needs and ensure payer communications are accurate, balanced, appropriately substantiated, and compliant.

• Convert payer feedback and policy trends into clear recommendations for evidence generation, publication strategy, value messaging, reimbursement tools, provider education, and account prioritization.

• Coordinate with Field Reimbursement Managers and Sales leadership to identify regional access barriers, distinguish account-level reimbursement issues from payer-policy issues, and establish appropriate escalation and follow-up pathways.

• Provide payer-policy interpretation and strategic guidance to internal stakeholders while avoiding guarantees of coverage or payment and preserving payer-specific nuance.

• Create executive-ready regional updates that summarize payer engagement, policy status, open barriers, opportunities, risks, decisions needed, and next actions.

• Represent Sight Sciences at payer meetings, medical society discussions, healthcare policy forums, and other relevant external engagements as assigned.

• Maintain accurate and timely documentation of payer interactions, policy milestones, commitments, evidence requests, and follow-up actions in approved company systems.

• Manage regional payer-relations projects, external consultants, budgets, and deliverables as assigned;

The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data.

At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. La persona seleccionada tendrá un papel clave en la definición del roadmap IAM a tres años, colaborando con responsables de seguridad y tecnología (CISO/CIO/CTO) y liderando iniciativas corporativas de Identity Governance, Access Management y Privileged Access Management.
🛠️ Requisitos imprescindibles

• Experiencia: entre 5 y 8 años en proyectos IAM, con experiencia real en implantaciones corporativas.

• Arquitectura IAM: diseño de arquitecturas de identidad, modelos de acceso y estándares de integración.

• Identity Governance (IGA): RBAC, ABAC, segregación de funciones (SoD), Access Reviews, Role Mining, Birthright Access e Identity Analytics.

• Plataformas IAM: experiencia con ISIM/ISVG y soluciones de gestión de identidades.

• Access Management: SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SCIM, federación, Passwordless y Adaptive MFA.

• Integración y desarrollo: APIs REST, JSON, XML y conocimientos de Java o Python. Se valorarán JavaScript, PowerShell y SQL.

• Directorios e identidad corporativa: Active Directory, LDAP, Microsoft Entra ID, ADFS, Google Workspace y entornos híbridos.

• Seguridad y accesos privilegiados: CyberArk, PAM, Zero Trust, PKI y gestión de secretos.

• Cloud: experiencia con Azure, AWS o GCP.

• Gobierno y cumplimiento: conocimientos de NIST e ISO 27001.

• Liderazgo: experiencia liderando proyectos IAM corporativos y capacidad para definir y presentar un roadmap tecnológico a perfiles ejecutivos.

🧩 Responsabilidades principales

• Diseñar y evolucionar la arquitectura IAM corporativa.

• Definir modelos de autorización RBAC/ABAC, políticas de acceso y estándares de identidad.

• Diseñar integraciones complejas entre aplicaciones, directorios y proveedores de identidad.

• Establecer estándares de autenticación y federación mediante SAML, OAuth 2.0 y OIDC.

• Liderar migraciones desde ADFS hacia proveedores de identidad modernos.

• Diseñar y mejorar los procesos Joiner, Mover, Leaver (JML) .

• Implantar y evolucionar procesos automatizados de certificación y revisión de accesos.

• Identificar riesgos IAM, revisar controles de seguridad y participar en auditorías.

• Definir la estrategia y el roadmap IAM a tres años, alineados con las necesidades de negocio y seguridad.

• Coordinarse con CISO, CIO, CTO y otros stakeholders para presentar propuestas de arquitectura y evolución tecnológica.

⭐ Competencias valoradas

• Arquitectura empresarial y visión estratégica.

• Liderazgo técnico en entornos corporativos complejos.

• Capacidad para traducir necesidades de negocio en soluciones técnicas.

• Comunicación y presentación de propuestas a perfiles ejecutivos.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
About Us

Chess.com is one of the largest gaming sites in the world and the #1 platform for playing, learning, and enjoying chess.

We are a team of 600+ fully remote people in 60+ countries working hard to serve the global chess community. We are here to support 250M+ chess players worldwide with the best possible product, content, and tools to serve the community!

We are a tech company. A gaming company. A content company. And we do it all with passion and commitment to the game. Above all we prize our mission-driven, flat, life-celebrating, no-corporate culture, and we look forward to meeting you and learning more about what you can bring to the team.

About The Role

The Cloud Engineer role is critical to scaling Chess.com 's infrastructure to support millions of daily chess games and serve global users. This position combines site reliability engineering expertise with cloud infrastructure management, directly impacting system performance, reliability, and scalability across Chess.com 's multi-regional distributed architecture. The role requires deep technical expertise in both infrastructure automation and application optimization to maintain Chess.com 's position as a high-traffic gaming platform while enabling rapid feature development and deployment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

•
Architect and optimize cloud-native infrastructure using Kubernetes, Terraform, and GitOps tools to support millions of concurrent chess games across multiple global regions

•
Lead performance optimization initiatives by analyzing Golang and TypeScript codebases to identify and resolve bottlenecks at scale, with specific focus on chess programming optimizations

•
Design and implement multi-regional resilient systems capable of handling extreme scale challenges including managing 1 million+ CPUs across dozens of regions

• Run and evolve our private Kubernetes cloud on bare-metal: a Rancher-managed fleet in our own datacenters that carries compute and IO intensive workloads, operated as one platform with GKE regions, with workloads placed wherever they get the best cost and performance.

•
Execute incident response and operational excellence serving as primary technical resource for critical infrastructure issues, ensuring rapid resolution and minimal downtime

•
Develop high-performance integration patterns for distributed systems handling extensive data volumes while maintaining reliability and scalability targets

•
Collaborate with development teams to implement cloud service integration best practices and optimize application deployment architectures

•
Implement Infrastructure as Code practices using Terraform to manage all cloud resources, ensuring consistent, automated, and scalable deployment processes

•
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines with GitOps approaches using tools like ArgoCD to enable rapid, reliable software delivery

•
Monitor and enhance system observability through implementation of modern monitoring stacks including Prometheus, Mimir, ES, Vector and Tempo

Qualifications

•
7+ years of experience managing large-scale, cloud-native distributed systems with proven ability to handle high-traffic production environments

•
Expert-level proficiency with Kubernetes including cluster deployment, management, and advanced orchestration patterns

•
Advanced Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform for managing complex cloud and Kubernetes resources in production

•
Strong programming skills in Golang with demonstrated ability to optimize high-performance services and troubleshoot complex codebases

•
Deep understanding of distributed systems design including failure modes, architectural principles, and data modeling strategies

•
Extensive experience with major cloud platforms (GCP, AWS) including advanced services, networking, and cost optimization

•
Proficiency with GitOps and CI/CD methodologies using modern deployment automation and continuous integration practices

•
Hands-on experience with observab

title: Senior Software Engineer II, Mobile - Revenue Experimentation (AI Native)
description:
About Life360

Life360 ’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.
Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).
Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit .
Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.
We are AI Native
We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.
Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.
About The Team
The Revenue Experimentation team (Direct Revenue org) is the engine behind how we grow and monetize Life360 responsibly. We design, ship, and analyze high-velocity experiments across ads, subscriptions, and one-time purchases - pricing, paywalls, ad placement and mediation, upsell and upgrade flows - so every monetization decision is grounded in evidence, not instinct. Our work directly shapes the revenue behind nearly 100 million members.
We are a product-minded, AI-Native engineering team. AI isn't just a tool we use - it's how we work. We treat it as a first-class collaborator at every stage: ideation, coding, testing, review, and iteration. We ship faster and go deeper because of it, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what that looks like at scale.
About the Job
Life360 is hiring an AI-Native Senior Software Engineer II - a builder who thinks natively in AI tooling and takes real ownership of outcomes, not just tickets. You'll be central to how the Revenue Experimentation team designs and ships growth and monetization experiments across the Life360 app.
You'll take a hypothesis - sometimes a fully-specced brief, sometimes a rough idea from a Slack thread or a data science finding - and turn it into a running, safely-instrumented experiment. You default to shipping and iterating rather than waiting for a perfect spec or explicit permission. You'll run experiments confidently at a high clip.

• Strong organizational and time management skills

title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
Do you love HR-but also want to make a real impact as a strategic partner to business leaders? Looking for a role where you can balance big-picture thinking with hands-on execution? We can help with that.
myHR Partner is growing, and we’re looking for a remote HR Business Partner to join our team. In this role, you’ll serve as a trusted advisor to multiple clients-helping them navigate everything HR while also rolling up your sleeves to get the work done.
This is not traditional consulting. Our team members are embedded, hands-on HR partners for our clients who build real relationships and deliver real results.

What a day in the life looks like:
As a true generalist and strategic partner, as an HR Business Partner, you’ll support a variety of small to midsize organizations-working directly with owners, executives, and leadership teams.

•
Act as a Strategic Partner: Build strong relationships with business leaders, understand their goals, and align HR strategies to support business growth and performance

•
Own the Full HR Function: Serve as an extension of your clients’ internal team-Exercise your expertise in everything HR.

•
Balance Strategy & Execution: Move seamlessly between big-picture planning and day-to-day HR support

•
Advise & Influence: Provide guidance on organizational structure, employee relations, performance management, compliance, and more

•
Execute Core HR Functions: Including benefits administration, policy development and implementation, payroll coordination, training, workers’ compensation, and compliance

•
Navigate Complexity: Support clients across multiple states and industries, adapting to varying regulations and business needs

•
Drive Proactive Solutions: Anticipate client needs, identify risks, and implement forward-thinking HR solutions

•
Manage Multiple Clients: Prioritize effectively, manage your time, and deliver a high-quality experience across all accounts

•
Build Strong Relationships: Serve as a trusted, approachable partner who clients rely on for both guidance and execution

What you need to thrive in this role:

•
Experience: 5+ years of progressive HR experience, ideally as a HR Manager or “HR department of one” supporting the full employee lifecycle

•
Strategic & Hands-On: Comfortable operating at both a strategic and tactical level-you can advise and execute

•
Business Partnership Mindset: Ability to build credibility with leadership and influence decisions

•
Adaptability: Thrive in a fast-paced environment supporting multiple clients with diverse needs

•
Relationship Builder: Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on trust, empathy, and communication

•
Problem Solver: Able to navigate complex situations and provide practical, compliant solutions

•
Education/Certifications: Degree in HR or Business (HR focus) and/or SHRM/HRCI certification required

•
Tech-Savvy: Experience with HRIS, payroll, and HR systems; comfortable learning new tools

•
Modern HR Approach: Align with a progressive, people-first philosophy

Location
Remote role within Eastern or Central Time Zones (occasional travel may be required).

About us
myHR Partner helps people. We step into organizations that don’t have an HR department-or need additional support-and provide hands-on, strategic HR services tailored to their business. We are HR professionals who think strategically and produce tangible results. Learn more:
What we offer you

• Fully company-paid employee benefits (yes-fully paid!)

• Medical, dental, vision insurance

• Telemedicine for the family

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

• Vacation and holiday pay

• Vacation days that increase annually

• Sick days

• Paid holidays + your birthday off + flexible holiday options

• 401(k) with generous match

• Professional development training

• Quarterly events, company retreat, and more

• Anniversary celebrations and gifts

• A drama-free work environment (we are HR after all!)

• Salary range: $69k-$79k
